primary_contribution: permutation-equivariant distributional branching MAC control quality under a frozen delivery and CH-reserve shield
accepted_contribution_statement: A permutation-equivariant distributional branching MAC policy, trained under shield-intervention distillation, converges close to a constrained delivery/reserve operating region with substantially less runtime correction than an unshielded heuristic under the identical constraint, yielding improved fairness, stale-drop control, and energy-normalized efficiency at matched horizons, while achieving comparable rather than superior survival time to the constraint mechanism alone.
